entries.title: Job 18:2
segments: Ye make an end; the words are addressed to Job, and seem to mean, thou and others that think and speak like thee.  So

entries.title: Job 18:3
segments:
We; Bildad and his two friends. 
 
Those who abuse or say hard things of others, are the persons who are most likely to be irritated and complain when others abuse or say hard things of them.

entries.title: Job 18:4
segments: He teareth himself; spoken of Job.

entries.title: Job 18:5
segments:
Shall be put out; his prosperity shall cease. 
 
Though evils greater than can be described are before the wicked, they may not come upon them in this life; and the idea of Bildad and his friends, that a man's character can be determined by his present outward condition, is false.  Their conclusion, therefore, concerning Job, that he must be a very wicked man, was utterly wrong.

entries.title: Job 18:7
segments: Be straitened; he shall become feeble.

entries.title: Job 18:9
segments: The robber shall prevail against him; or, as some render, the snare shall seize upon him.

entries.title: Job 18:12
segments:
Be hunger-bitten; fail through hunger. 
 
The righteous and the wicked may both in this world be visited by trials; and a just discrimination between them may never fully appear till they enter the world of spirits.

entries.title: Job 18:13
segments:
The strength of his skin; or the members of his skin; that is, his body. 
 
  The first-born of death; death in the most terrible form.

entries.title: Job 18:14
segments: It shall bring him to the king of terrors; the calamity sent upon him from God shall bring him down to death.

entries.title: Job 18:15
segments:
It is none of his; it is no longer his secure resting-place, being taken from him and desolated by God's judgments. 
 
  Brimstone shall be scattered; possibly with allusion to the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah.

entries.title: Job 18:17
segments:
No name in the street; there shall be none to speak of him, or keep him in remembrance after he is dead. 
 
The memory of the wicked shall rot, but the righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

entries.title: Job 18:19
segments: Neither have son nor nephew; he shall leave no posterity.

entries.title: Job 18:20
segments:
They that come after him; men of a later day, who hear of his terrible overthrow. 
 
  His day; the day of his destruction. 
 
  They that went before; that lived with him; his contemporaries. 
 
  Were affrighted; at the greatness of his calamities.
